title: Steuerrecht.com delivers client-ready legal analysis with ChatGPT
summary: Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to streamline legal workflows, automate tax research, and deliver faster, client-ready analysis for law firms.
body: Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to streamline legal workflows, automate tax research, and deliver faster, client-ready analysis for law firms.
summaryZh: 法律服务平台Steuerrecht.com引入ChatGPT Business以优化其工作流程。该平台利用大模型自动化税务研究，为律所提供更快速且可直接交付客户的法律分析。这体现了大语言模型在特定垂直行业如法律与税务领域的实用落地案例。
